name: deck-config
body: `kalide.yaml` holds deck-wide config: `title` (required), optional `author` (presenter), optional `date` written as `YYYY-MM-DD`, optional `theme` (default `default`), optional `navigation` (default|linear|grid, default `default`), optional `properties` (arbitrary author-declared deck-wide key/value pairs — see deck-properties), and optional `templates` (path to the deck's external template library directory — see external-template-library); `properties` and `templates` are the two additional allowed top-level keys. The `templates:` value is captured at `kalide start` startup and pins the session's library root; changing it while the server runs is a restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart), not a live retarget. Missing `title` = error; `date` not in `YYYY-MM-DD` form = error; every other unknown top-level key = error with a closest-match suggestion (consistent with field rules); wrong types = error. The legacy file name `eypres.yaml` is not recognised (hard cut; see kalide-rename).
